migration.migration_reason: Legacy paid evidence is scientifically unchanged; only the scoped Task Packet/fingerprint representation changed. Every non-scoped dependency and selected prompt component was proved identical, except that Learnability may project away the explicitly Semantic Compression-only worker-core output-transport section after the remaining worker rules compare byte-for-byte.

I1_keyword_anonymization.description: Grammar keywords (if/for/int/return/class) replaced by pseudo-tokens qelp/zorf/yenk/dravel/munt in the prompt glossary; ordinary identifiers and all standard-library/builtin names (System.out.println, %) left untouched and used verbatim by the model.
I1_keyword_anonymization.per_metric_breakdown_note: All sub-metrics (compile/parse success, Correct@1, Correct@N, test pass rate, repair success/efficiency, spec compliance, hallucination resistance, silent-bug resistance, unseen-case generalization, source/total token efficiency) scored 100 in each of the 3 seeds: every completion compiled on the first attempt (Correct@1==Correct@N, no repair turns consumed -- see trials/i1-*/session.json, repairs_used=0), produced the exact expected stdout '30' with no extraneous output, used no invented/hallucinated APIs, and was concise (<=~15 lines).

I2_vocabulary_anonymization.description: I1 anonymization plus standard-library/builtin names anonymized in the prompt glossary: println renamed to 'zant.blenk(x)' and modulo renamed to 'wibmod'; model must map both back to real Java (System.out.println, %) purely from the prose specification.
I2_vocabulary_anonymization.per_metric_breakdown_note: Same sub-metric composition as I1; additionally hallucination resistance was specifically checked against inventing an actual 'zant.blenk' or 'wibmod' API call in the emitted Java (none did -- all 3 completions correctly emitted System.out.println and the real % operator), confirming vocabulary was learned from spec rather than recalled by name.

evidence.methodology: Section 10 llm_learnability I1/I2, weights per condition metric table (Compile 7%, Correct@1 18%, Correct@N 8%, Test Pass Rate 15%, Repair Success 8%, Repair Efficiency 6%, Spec Compliance 10%, Hallucination Resistance 8%, Silent Bug Resistance 10%, Unseen-case Generalization 7%, Source Token Eff 1%, Total Token Eff 2%). llm_learnability.keyword_anonymization_seeds=3 and vocabulary_anonymization_seeds=3 (primary.json), run exactly as fresh independent trials via trial_start.
evidence.preflight_and_leakage: See learnability_preflight.json and learnability_leakage.json in this directory; both passed with real compile/run evidence (Main_ref.java -> stdout '30' positive control, Main_neg.java -> stdout '20' negative control).
evidence.raw_trial_artifacts: See trials/i1-t{1,2,3}/ and trials/i2-t{1,2,3}/ (prompt_01.txt, completion_01.txt, session.json) and score_results.json / run_i1-t*//run_i2-t*/ compiled-and-executed Main.java copies in this worker directory for full reproducibility.
evidence.task_fixture: Single held-out arithmetic/control-flow task: sum of even integers from 1 to 10 inclusive, printed to stdout. Ground truth stdout = '30', established by compiling/running Main_ref.java in the sandbox during preflight (see learnability_preflight.json). Validator = exact stdout match after 'javac Main.java && java Main'.
